## @interlace/reflection-card

Installed to `components/ui/games/reflection-card.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/reflection-card';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/reflection-card
